mission.title: Best Interests
mission.description: Disrupt the Zionite groups trying to arrange a meeting with the intruder.

npc.say:
Oh, don't worry; I'm not about to go blabbing it to Zion, either. Only, they're a little more likely to tell me what I want to know, see?
Now, buzz off.
I know that this has not answered all of your questions, operative, but vital security concerns prohibit me from disclosing further information.

phase.briefing:
Operative, we have confirmation that Zion has contacted the intruder. There are indications that they are even now attempting to arrange for some of their high-ranking officers to meet with him. Since we are able to track him to a certain extent, we have been able to correlate the motions of the intruder and detected Zionites, and can anticipate and disrupt the Zionite groups likely to be involved.
One of these groups is your current target. You are to remove them from the simulation.

enter.say:
Seems like we're fighting a losing battle... If we can't do anything to this guy, Zion's going to get a hold of him sooner or later. Gray said before that we know his communication channel, so why don't we...
Ah, hell. Anyway, I'm picking up non-System redpill signals in there. Should be our group of Zionites.

done.say: I guess that's it. Now we'll call Gray, and end up fighting the same bunch somewhere else nearby once they've reconstructed...

phase.briefing: Sightings of Zion's Captain Niobe and Ghost have been reported. This would seem to corroborate the theory that Zion is attempting to hold a high-level meeting with the intruder. However, some units are...experiencing difficulties, which is hampering our ability to intercept Zionite groups before they reach him. It is therefore of the utmost importance that you eliminate your next designated target quickly.

enter.say:
So here we are running in circles around the intruder, shaking a stick at the Zionites. Sooner or later Niobe's going to reach him, and then what? Our Agents couldn't bust up that meeting with him there.
I just don't see this going anywhere but downhill...
Yeah, redpill signals in there. I swear, if I recognize any of them from the last bunch, I'm gonna scream.

done.say:
You know what? Forget it. This is stupid. It's bull that Zion's going to get answers from this guy before we do, especially when we know exactly where he is.
I'm changing the program. Get outside.

phase.briefing:
Operative, you have left the area without eliminating your target. Do you require assistance?
Please respond, {player}.

enter.say:
Yeah, he's in there, all right; no way the unidentified code with power levels like the ones I'm seeing could be anything else we know of.
Time to get some answers.

talk.say:
So, you'd like to know what this is all about? I'm sure you would...but I'm not stupid enough to let that out. Neither are the Machines, if they know what's good for them.
Hm... But if they really did know that, I wouldn't have had to come here in the first place. Blasted 'bots.

done.say:
...
Then they do know, and haven't been telling us. So, what, is this guy blackmailing them? How could that be possible?

near.say: You're getting closer. I'm starting to get some pretty erratic readings. That whole area's going to destabilize...

Operative, report.
Operative, do you read me? Return to your designated target immediately.

phase.briefing: {player}.. It may be that a certain amount of explanation is overdue. I will-- Agent Pace will give you what information we are at liberty to discuss.

enter.say: She's in there. How much you want to bet that she's gonna give us a batty-eyed brush-off?

talk.say:
Ciao, {player}. As your operator has guessed, there is, unfortunately, little that I can impart to you regarding the intruder... His presence--even his very existence--is inextricably linked with information that cannot be compromised without severe risk to the System.
It is true that his manifestation within the simulation is causing localized instability. You see, the Matrix was not designed to support the...ah...override codes he is using. That is partly why he is so dangerous. Since we have not been able to prevent his presence in the Matrix, we must strive to minimize the disturbance he creates. It is therefore important that we do not aggravate him to the point of violence, if it can be avoided.

mission.finish: Our...apologies if we cannot be more forthcoming, operative. I assure you that your satisfaction level is important to us, particularly in light of the difficulties caused to our programs by the intruder's codes. We look forward to a time when we will be more...at liberty to discuss these issues with you.
